title: H8 fix round 1: bus_events derives events, next_since and truncated from one query so a concurrent insert cannot redeliver or skip events (review T-0372)
spec:
STEP 0: the worktree must contain f43c354 (T-0360, H8) in git log; never drop or amend it.
Review T-0372 on T-0360, one finding:
1. (med) orchestrator/bus_mcp.py:49 bus_events runs two non-atomic queries on the shared autocommit sqlite connection: bus.events(since, limit) for the raw page (to compute next_since and truncated) and bus.events(since, limit, role, task_ids) for the filtered rows. A concurrent insert between the two lets the filtered result include seq values beyond the raw page's last seq, so the next poll with since=next_since redelivers them (and the mirror case can skip). Fix: fetch the unfiltered page once (limit rows ordered by seq) and apply the role and task_ids filters in Python on that same list; next_since is the last seq of the unfiltered page, truncated is len(page) == limit; the filtered list therefore never contains a seq above next_since. Keep bus.events' own optional filters for other callers but make bus_mcp use the single-fetch path. Test: tests/test_bus.py::test_events_filtered_page_never_exceeds_next_since (simulate an insert between the fetch and the filter by monkeypatching, assert every returned seq is at most next_since) and keep test_events_role_filter_keeps_seq_and_cursor and test_events_truncated_flag_and_next_since green.
Keep every T-0360 test and the existing suite green. Run .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh from the worktree root until it exits 0, then git add -A and git commit with the task id; report sha and failures only.
acceptance: git log --oneline in the worktree shows f43c354 below your commit
bus_mcp.bus_events calls the event query once per request (grep)
Existing tests pass; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0 in the worktree
